name: GM_ON_CARRIER
meaning: last move's ContactInfo.movableObj was non-NULL (standing on a class-flag-4 carrier); keeps the fall stage alive

name: GM_FALLING
meaning: fall/move stage active: set by msg 0xb/0x25 when not attached, or whenever a mover is linked; cleared on a static-floor landing with no carrier and no mover

name: GM_FORCED
meaning: magnet pull (msg 0x53) this frame: triggers without a target and blocks the cancel check; cleared at the end of every proximity-mode update

name: GM_COUNTDOWN
meaning: proximity fuse running (cancellable); cleared whenever state != 3
